title: FBI September 2023 Sighting - Serial 5
doc_notes: This document is an FBI FD-302 interview report regarding a UAP sighting by a contractor in September 2023, featuring heavy redactions of names and specific locations.

incidents.summary: A contractor observed a metallic, linear object with a bright white light while traveling to a test site.
behavior: moved east to west parallel to the ground
incidents.quote: saw a linear object with a super bright light on the east side of the object.
incidents.size: one to two Blackhawk helicopters in length
